channel.title: Montay — news
channel.description: Montay is a Paris-based alternative rock band. Songs, lyrics, videos, photos and news — including the EP A Girl From The Islands.

item.title: We're working on our second EP
item.description: New creative territory and fresh sounds after A Girl From The Islands — with behind-the-scenes to come.

item.title: New video: Entertained (live)
item.description: A live recording of Entertained is up on YouTube. The studio version lands on the second EP.

item.title: Live at Supersonic for the EP launch
item.description: Montay on stage at Supersonic, Paris, to launch the EP A Girl From The Islands.

item.title: Official video: People We Don't Know
item.description: The official video for People We Don't Know, from the Montay EP A Girl From The Islands, is out now on YouTube.

item.title: Official video: You Wish You Had Time
item.description: Our first official video, for You Wish You Had Time, is out now on YouTube — from the EP A Girl From The Islands.

item.title: New EP: A Girl From The Islands is out
item.description: A Girl From The Islands, the first Montay EP — five songs — is out now and available on every streaming platform.

item.title: New photos in the gallery
item.description: A fresh batch of live shots and portraits from Montay has been added to the photo gallery.
